# MDE Action Center

**What this dashboard shows:** Real-time view of Defender XDR Action Center events — automated investigations, response actions, Live Response sessions, and per-machine action results. The 10-minute polling cadence (ActionCenter tier) makes this the SOC's near-real-time signal for active response activity.

**Use cases:**
- **SOC analyst stand-up**: review incidents AIR is investigating + outstanding LR sessions
- **IR responder**: track approved/pending actions across the fleet
- **Detection engineer**: validate that AIR investigations triggered for expected alert patterns
- **Audit response**: who ran what LR session, when, and on which machines

**Data sources:** `Defender_ActionCenter_CL` (MDE_ActionCenter_CL — covers all machine actions: Isolate/UnIsolate/AntivirusScan/CollectInvestigationPackage/LR/AIR via canonical /actionCenter/actioncenterui/history-actions endpoint) — 10-minute cadence ActionCenter tier.

content.title: Action Center summary by status
content.query:
Defender_ActionCenter_CL | where SourceName == 'MDE_ActionCenter_CL'
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by ActionId
| summarize Count = count() by ActionStatus, ActionType
| order by Count desc

content.title: Device timeline events (per-device)
content.query:
Defender_EndpointDeviceManagement_CL | where SourceName == 'MDE_DeviceTimeline_CL'
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| project EventTime, MachineId, EventType, EventId, ProcessName, FileName, Severity, TimeGenerated
| order by EventTime desc
| take 200

content.title: Machine actions detail (Live Response output and AIR linkage)
content.query:
Defender_ActionCenter_CL | where SourceName == 'MDE_ActionCenter_CL'
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by ActionId
| extend DurationMinutes = iff(isnotnull(CompletedTime) and isnotnull(CreatedTime), datetime_diff('minute', CompletedTime, CreatedTime), int(null))
| project CreatedTime, CompletedTime, DurationMinutes, ActionId, ActionType, ActionStatus, MachineId, Operator, InvestigationId, ScriptOutput, TimeGenerated
| order by CreatedTime desc
